title: Persistence with localStorage
summary: Keep state across page loads by writing it to localStorage in an effect and reading it back with a lazy initial state. You will version the stored shape so that a value saved by an older version of the page cannot crash the new one, and check that a saved list survives a reload.
changeNote: Rewritten so each step opens with an explainer or a prediction, folds the background under Read more, and ends with a quiz.
